new_libraries.name: CiftPulsarOTA
new_libraries.author: Bilgin Demir CAN (bcan77)
new_libraries.sentence: ESP32 OTA update receiver for Cift Pulsar — WiFi HTTP (universal) + BLE.
new_libraries.paragraph: Arduino library that receives OTA firmware updates on ESP32 via WiFi HTTP (works on any browser/OS, AP or STA) and BLE (Web Bluetooth). Includes version/update detection, mDNS, progress callbacks, and safe Update handling. Works with https://bcan77.github.io/ciftpulsar-ota/

new_libraries.name: LagariMotors
new_libraries.author: LAGARI A <lagariscience@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Internal beta - UDP command system for integrated servo/stepper drives (Modbus-RTU / RS-485) on Controllino.
new_libraries.paragraph: Hardened Modbus-RTU transport (CRC-verified responses, exception detection, retries, real timeouts), unit-correct motor control (position, velocity, homing, zero/position redefinition), a non-blocking status monitor that pushes limit-switch, fault and online/offline events over UDP, and a full command set (P, PA, S, SD, B, L, BS, Z, ZO, ZS, R, I, X plus V/VA/VS/HV/H extensions). Internal test build - not the final public release.
